display_name: Paul, brother of Pausirius and Theodotion

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιοι Παύλος, Παυσίριος και Θεοδοτίων οι Αυτάδελφοι», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιοι Παύλος, Παυσίριος και Θεοδοτίων οι Αυτάδελφοι»

attestations.note: The three are brothers in the flesh and share one page; saint.gr prints one distich for Paul and Pausirius together and a second for Theodotion.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr gives no year, only the reigns: «έζησαν κατά τους χρόνους των αυτοκρατόρων Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.) και Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.)», and it is Diocletian's persecution that takes them. The interval is the reign the page prints.
